audit.whatIsWrong: content win[] and the packet levelChart give Zyra all 7 rows, but full.phases[0..6].side are still the flat 'Skill' template on every row.
audit.why: Deadly Spines (Q) and Grasping Roots (E, flat 11s CD) out-range Maokai's whole kit and seed a plant field that keeps chunking through 2+ items; her R knocks up and blooms every plant if she lands E first.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].side moved to Zyra with matching ratings/why.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Grasping Roots as matchup-defining but never states the actual cooldown number.
audit.why: Grasping Roots (E) is a flat 11-second cooldown per champ-data/_kits/zyra.json (not per-rank), unlike most support CC.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither the current page nor the missing-interactions file states that Zyra's Q (Deadly Spines) and E (Grasping Roots) both carry the 'grounding' flag — they shut off Twisted Advance's dash outright, not just root you after you land.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/zyra.json flags Q and E both as 'grounding: shuts off enemy dashes'. Engaging into either up ability doesn't just risk a trade, it can cancel Maokai's only gap-closer mid-flight.
audit.corrected: Added the grounding fact to phases[2].why and tradeBad.

edits.before: Sapling the brush — the lane's hedges are yours now; trades start with a tree's consent.
edits.after: Deadly Spines (Q) seeds plants that chunk you for stepping up, and you have no ranged answer in your kit at level 1.

edits.before: W threat begins: the point-click root governs their carry's spacing.
edits.after: Grasping Roots' 11-second cooldown root plus plant damage punishes any walk-up — eating it chunks your ADC before you reach W range.

edits.before: Full kit: E-zone the trades, W the commits, Q the disengage — the swamp votes.
edits.after: Her Q and E both ground dashes — contesting into a live Grasping Roots doesn't just trade, it cancels Twisted Advance mid-flight.

edits.before: Sustain the margins with passive heals and sapling chip — attrition is a tree's game.
edits.after: Her plants and poke keep out-damaging whatever Sap Magic sustain you claw back — the range war stays hers until her E is down.

edits.before: Nature's Grasp online — the root wave starts fights from fog and ends dives in it.
edits.after: Stranglethorns knocks up and blooms every plant — landing E first turns your W-into-R engage into a fight you lose.

edits.before: First item: the roots chain and the saplings tax every brush.
edits.after: Lost Chapter lets her spam Q-E poke and zone you and your ADC off the wave every trade.

edits.before: Late Maokai is the engage forest: R the formation, W the carry, and Q whatever the roots deliver.
edits.after: Her plant field and R still melt your frontline at range — only a flank W while Grasping Roots is down gets you past the grounding.

edits.before: - Zyra Grasping Roots: matchup-defining — The root blooms the garden on the held — dodge it behind minions. It writes your spacing rules. - Q Bramble Smash is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Zyra Grasping Roots (E): flat 11s cooldown — it grounds your W mid-dash, so it's not just CC, it cancels the engage outright. - Q Bramble Smash is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: W the instant Grasping Roots misses — its flat 11-second cooldown is the only window her grounding can't shut your dash off.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Dashing into a live Grasping Roots or Deadly Spines — both ground your W mid-flight and cancel the engage outright.
